While corporations definitely wield significant power through lobbying and financial contributions, politicians and the media play critical roles in shaping narratives and policy decisions. Ultimately, the influence of corporations is substantial, but it's important to recognize that politicians and the media also have their own forms of power that can counterbalance corporate interests.
